name: gals
description: GALS (Grid Application Layout Systems) — lightweight flex grid frontend toolkit and its documentation site.

scripts.build:css: sass --style=expanded --source-map --no-charset style.scss style.css && postcss style.css --map --use autoprefixer --replace
scripts.build:cdn: sass --style=compressed --no-source-map --no-charset gals/gals.css cdn/gals.min.css && terser gals/gals.js --compress --mangle --comments false --output cdn/gals.min.js
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:cdn && npm run build:llms
